title: RAW UNREVIEWED: material replacement comes from the written chey tal selector, not an atomic saiin alternative
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. In the whole existing f83r.9–17 amulet draft, try s+aiin=additional provenance at both C02 and C07. The later written chey tal=INSTEAD_OF THAT_PART, not fusion or the isolated saiin word, selects a replacement physical component. This must preserve the eagle depiction while changing the material bird option and use the same underlying construction across split ZL and fused IT.

design.mechanism: Replace the atomic ALTERNATIVELY value of saiin by the same s=ALSO and aiin=typed OF already present in C02. A shared replacement construction OF(source-kind,part-kind) ... INSTEAD_OF(bound-part) proposes another material for that bound role; absent the written replacement selector, ALSO OF adds a provenance assertion rather than a mutually exclusive plan branch.
design.unit: Complete f83r.9–17 in the existing84-group projected/ZL and83-group IT records. Both full C02 and C07 and every following placement/enclosure/claim clause remain in scope. Complete f108r.45–47 is retained as the existing same-material commentary, without new values.
design.contrast: A compositional provenance-plus-written-replacement construction versus atomic saiin=ALTERNATIVELY, a bare whitespace scope rule, or adding both bird parts to the assembly.
design.prediction: C02 s aiin/saiin adds a physical provenance assertion because it has no chey tal replacement selector. C07 saiin ... chey tal offers the hawk part in place of the already introduced physical component. The depicted eagle remains unchanged, and the same placement operator must place one selected part with the seed, not both physical bird options.
design.scope: New explicit C0 grammar version, not a rerun or repair of GDT1038 fixed literal tag sequences. No new word meanings, but decomposition and replacement-scope/argument-order rules are new costs.

additional_assumptions: Remove the old atomic ALTERNATIVELY entry only for this declared new version; keep its original source and all failed GDT1038 cases unchanged. saiin is always s+aiin in this offer, never atomic at a convenient occurrence.

The provenance expression must bind explicit source/body/material types. C02 uses a left physical-part argument, C07 names the bird kind before WING_TIP; any typed argument-order convention that derives both must be written and counted.

INSTEAD_OF THAT_PART must bind the same physical role P introduced earlier, not the depicted IMAGE or grape seed. This reference is already part of the old reading but must now be supplied by a reusable written selector, not C07 identity tables.

The source allows an eagle or hawk physical part while preserving an eagle image. It does not identify s, aiin, chey or tal; all inherited71/88 guessed values remain hypothetical and do not share a dictionary with the seed-rite T01.
The full replacement phrase creates an alternative instruction branch, not an executed removal of an already fitted object. Simple additive provenance alone does not cause an operation.
two_discriminating_consequences: The literal IT C02 saiin must behave like ZL s aiin without becoming an alternative physical ingredient. A fusion-only semantics is already contradicted; the new account uses the complete written replacement selector and therefore makes a different, inspectable commitment.

At C07, replacing the bird source through chey tal must carry into the same shcthy placement and the later enclosure/claim assembly while leaving sor shedy/KEEP_IMAGE eagle content unchanged. A parse that merely asserts that the image is a hawk, or places both eagle and hawk physical tips, fails this shared construction under its declared old values. These are consequences of the C0 account, not source-target confirmation.
strongest_known_countercases: GDT1038 tested the old frozen expected tags: a fully decomposed reading fails where an atomic alternative was required. This proposal changes that semantic production openly; it cannot be reported as success of the old test.
The original f83r actual readers still have unbound forms and raw entities. Deriving C02/C07 does not complete an83/84-group translation or resolve original IT cheen/ram etc.

Without a fixed rule assigning OF arguments and binding chey tal to the same P, this is just a paraphrase of the old branch macro and adds no written information. Type-directed selection can hide occurrence-specific fitting; every choice must be exposed.
RAW492/GDT1038 extension constrains no new physical outcome under the old model; SAME material there is a later reference obligation, not independent evidence for this decomposition.
Universal s prefix semantics is not established; old GDT314/766 s-entry effects and seed-rite s=THE remain separate rival constructions, not inherited ALSO evidence.
